title: 第一卷 第13章 你格局大，喊声爸爸听听
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季望棉闻声走出来隔着门缝往外看。

一个身穿绿色军装的中年女人，长相倒是符合医生的和善，圆脸，齐耳短发，站姿笔直，格外的精神。

“她就是丁主任，孙贝贝的妈妈？”

“可不是，就是她，这丁主任平时人也不错，但是只要事关她一儿一女，她这个人就有点不讲理，我看你就躲在这里，敲门没人应，她就回去了！这种事最好是萧团长处理，本来就是他惹出来的。”

季望棉觉得有道理，但是她从来不是躲着的人，甚至还有些兴奋。

冲着王芬华柔柔一笑：“没关系的芬华姐，丁主任好歹是长辈，避而不见的话，我怕对萧大哥有影响，我无所谓的。”

王芬华一拍大腿。

棉棉哟~~这是有多爱萧团长，自己吓得小脸都白了，害怕影响萧团长的仕途，还强撑着走出去。

不行，她得跟上去看看。

季望棉自然地走到自己家门口，抬头一双无辜的眼睛看向丁桂兰和两位嫂子。

声音柔柔：“婶子们好！”

两位婶子冲她点头，丁桂兰直接愣在原地：“你是，萧临戍的未婚妻？”

她在家里思前想后，一个农村的丫头而已，最多是乡下人白一点，长得好看一点。

哪有大家传的那么夸张，她又不是没去过乡下。

每年忆苦思甜的时候，她没少去乡下走动义诊，乡下姑娘长的真没几个能入眼的，有的就算五官好看，一身晒黑的皮肤也让她们减分不少。

她闺女可是她细心养护长大的，白白嫩嫩，五官也不丑，一定能让对方自惭形秽，大不了给点钱，合理范围内提点要求都好说。

但是这些在面对季望棉的时候都消失了。

肤如凝脂，目如灿星，眉眼弯弯，笑起来天都暖了几分。

如果随便换个人家的未婚妻，她想她是喜欢跟这种人接触的。

季望棉很满意自己达到的效果，疑惑地看向丁桂兰：“这位婶子站在我家门口，是有事吗？”

丁桂兰这才回神，眼神游离一下这才开口：“你叫我丁婶子就行，我是有点事要跟你说。”

但是不方便在这里，最好只有我们两个人。

季望棉眉头一动，故作疑惑：“丁婶子，找我有事?你说，虽然我身无分文，还没有工作，不知道能帮你什么，但是只要你说，我一定尽力而为，我大伯经常教育我们，每个人都是雷锋，要乐于助人。”

谈可以，你是给钱还是给工作？

丁桂兰不可置信地看着她，觉得一定是自己想错了，一个乡下人怎么可能跟她们一样，一句话转好几个弯。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Wangmian heard the sound and came out to look out through the crack in the door.

A middle-aged woman wearing a green military uniform, her appearance is in line with the kindness of a doctor, with a round face, short ear-length hair, standing upright, and extraordinarily energetic.

"She is Director Ding, Sun Beibei's mother?"

"No, it's her. Director Ding is usually a nice person, but as long as it concerns her son and daughter, she is a bit unreasonable. I think you are hiding here. No one answers the knock on the door, so she goes back! It is best for Captain Xiao to handle this kind of thing. He was the one who caused it."

Ji Wangmian thought it made sense, but she had never been one to hide, and she was even a little excited.

She smiled softly at Wang Fenhua: "It's okay, Sister Fenhua. Director Ding is an elder after all. If you avoid him, I'm afraid it will have an impact on Brother Xiao. I don't care."

Wang Fenhua slapped her thigh.

Mianmian~~ This is how much I love Captain Xiao. I was so scared that my face turned pale. I was afraid of affecting Captain Xiao’s career, so I still forced myself to go out.

No, she had to follow him and take a look.

Ji Wangmian walked to the door of his house naturally, raised his head and looked at Ding Guilan and his two sisters-in-law with a pair of innocent eyes.

In a soft voice: "Hello, aunts!"

The two aunts nodded at her, but Ding Guilan froze on the spot: "Are you Xiao Linshu's fiancée?"

She thought about it at home. She was just a girl from the countryside. At most, she was a bit fairer and good-looking.

It's not as exaggerated as everyone said. It's not like she has never been to the countryside.

Every year when she was thinking about her sorrows and sweetness, she often went to the countryside for free clinics. There were really not many girls in the countryside who were attractive to look at. Even if some of them had good-looking facial features, their tanned skin would take away a lot of their points.

Her daughter was raised by her carefully. She is fair and tender, and her facial features are not ugly. She will definitely make the other party feel ashamed. At the most, she can give her some money, or she can ask for something within a reasonable range.

But all these disappeared when facing Ji Wangmian.

Her skin is like cream, her eyes are like stars, her eyebrows are curved, and the sky feels a little warmer when she smiles.

If it were any other person's fiancée, she thought she would like to be in contact with this kind of person.

Ji Wangmian was very satisfied with the results he had achieved and looked at Ding Guilan doubtfully: "This aunt is standing at the door of my house. Is there something wrong?"

Ding Guilan finally came back to her senses. Her eyes wandered for a moment before she spoke: "Just call me Aunt Ding. I have something to tell you."

But it’s not convenient here, it’s best just the two of us.

Ji Wangmian frowned and pretended to be confused: "Aunt Ding, what do you want from me? You said, although I am penniless, have no job, and don't know what I can do to help you, but as long as you ask me, I will do my best. My uncle often teaches us that everyone is Lei Feng and should be willing to help others."

It's okay, will you give me money or a job?

Ding Guilan looked at her in disbelief, feeling that she must have thought wrong. How could a countryman make multiple turns in one sentence like them?
